title: Anthropic launches Claude Opus 5 with efficiency and safety improvements
summary: Anthropic released Claude Opus 5 on July 24, 2026, priced at $5 per million input tokens and $25 per million output tokens (unchanged from predecessor Opus 4.8), roughly half the cost of Anthropic's flagship Fable 5. It becomes the new default model on Claude Max and the strongest available on Claude Pro, and is accessible via API as claude-opus-5. Anthropic says Opus 5 beat Fable 5 on 8 of 13 benchmarks despite the lower price, with notable gains on Frontier-Bench and AutomationBench, and touts it as the company's most aligned model to date with no data-retention requirement. The launch reflects a shift in AI competition toward cost-efficient, near-frontier models for everyday enterprise coding and knowledge work rather than pure peak capability.

title: Anthropic launches Claude Opus 5 AI model
summary: Anthropic released Claude Opus 5 on July 24, 2026, a model priced at $5 per million input tokens and $25 per million output tokens (unchanged from predecessor Opus 4.8), pitched as delivering performance close to flagship Claude Fable 5 at half the API cost. It scored 43.3% on Frontier Bench v0.1 versus Fable 5's 33.7% on internal benchmarks, becomes the new default model on Claude Max and the strongest option on Claude Pro, and features improved coding/agent capabilities, less restrictive cybersecurity safeguards, no 30-day data retention requirement, and is described by Anthropic as its most aligned model to date.

title: Attackers bypassed MFA in 100% of business email compromise cases analyzed
summary: MSSP Alert reports attackers bypassed MFA in every business email compromise (BEC) case examined where MFA was in place, and are also stealing OAuth tokens, API keys, and machine identities to gain trusted access to cloud systems without triggering alarms. Common techniques include OAuth device-code phishing (abusing Microsoft 365's OAuth 2.0 Device Authorization Grant flow), MFA-fatigue attacks, adversary-in-the-middle proxies stealing session tokens/cookies, SIM swapping, and exploiting legacy protocols (IMAP, SMTP, POP) that don't support MFA. The findings underscore that MFA alone is no longer sufficient defense against identity-based attacks and AI-driven social engineering.

The game stars Deborah Ann Woll as Laufey (formerly Faye), Kratos's late Norse wife, marking the first mainline entry without Kratos as protagonist, set in an afterlife realm called the Everywhen. Franchise creative head Cory Barlog confirmed a separate, already-in-development Kratos-led sequel that connects directly to Laufey's story, with February 2027 also hosting Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis, Persona 4 Revival, Fable, and Metro 2039.

Massive wildfires in Spain and France force evacuation of 250,000+ people
summary: Wildfires forced over 250,000 people to flee in southwest France (141,000 in Gironde and Landes) and Spain (60,000 in Madrid region plus 10,000 more). Spain declared a national emergency across two regions as blazes near Madrid burned nearly 10,000 hectares and merged with fires in Avila province (13,000-15,000 hectares); French President Macron mobilized the military as a fire approached Bordeaux. No deaths reported, though dozens of firefighters were injured; some residents fled by boat as blazes hit France's Atlantic coast, and Spain has already burned about 500 square miles in 2026, over four times the total from the first half of 2025.
